summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a monthly dividend declaration for September 2026, reflecting a targeted annualized dividend of $1.60 per share. The record date is September 30, 2026, and the payment date is October 15, 2026, with a per-share dividend of $0.13150685. No strategic event or special situation is involved; this is a routine operational disclosure of a scheduled dividend.
